description: The Dynamics 365 write log of this tenant: one entry per change made through DelegAIze, newest first — time, tool, entity, Dynamics id, the record's NAME and the outcome (ok/failed). The entry is written BEFORE the change is sent, so failed attempts show up too. Filter: tool_name. Changes nothing.

tool_name.description: Only entries written by this tool

name: list_dynamics_write_log
